name: aiodize
description: Your brain for AI, on your device. Gives Claude your notes, projects, rules and work history from Aiodize.
long_description: Aiodize keeps your notes, projects and ideas as plain Markdown on your computer. This extension connects Claude Desktop to one Aiodize workspace: Claude reads your context before it works and logs what changed after. Everything stays on your device. Needs Aiodize installed (node setup.js) and its folder set below.

aiodize_folder.title: Aiodize folder
aiodize_folder.description: Where Aiodize is installed (the folder with setup.js).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Which Aiodize workspace Claude may see, for example personal. Install the extension once per workspace you want in Claude Desktop.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Rules, project, pending items and recent work for a folder

tools.name: log_work
tools.description: Log what changed to the project note

tools.name: setup_status
tools.description: What is set up so far

tools.name: propose_setup
tools.description: Propose a setup for you to review in Aiodize

prompts.name: load_context
prompts.text: Use the get_context tool with folder ${arguments.folder} and follow the rules it returns.

prompts.name: log_this_work
prompts.text: Summarise what we did in this conversation in one or two sentences, then call log_work with that summary, the next steps and the status if it changed.
